name: review-loop
description: Assisted review loop — local reviewers answer blind and in parallel, each returns its own convergence verdict (loop-until-dry, facilitator owns K + escalation); a behaviour claim about a runtime prompt is settled by five independent simulation runs, not by a string comparison; roster enrolled per host via /review-loop:init; never merges autonomously; ships an always-on UserPromptSubmit hook that writes nothing until you opt in via /review-loop:init
